intro.title: UNINVITED COMPANY
intro.body: A rust-pocked ship closes on your port side. Weapons powered. {npc.quirk}
intro.line: Hail, little ship. Cut your engines. We'll make this quick.

ai.aria: The weapons are charged in a very spirited way!
ai.marv: Their fuel reserves suggest they cannot chase us far. But far enough.
ai.rex: Threat assessment: moderate. Recommending weapons free.
ai.chip: Protection insurance add-on is available. Ask me how.
ai.ajoy: You could fight. You could flee. You could talk. One works better than you think.

choices.detail: The engineer braces the hull for the hit.

negotiate.title: NEGOTIATION
negotiate.body: They're listening — for now. The captain's hand hovers over the weapons panel.

ai.marv: They will not accept the first offer. Or the second.
ai.rex: If diplomacy fails I am already aiming.
ai.chip: Transcripts of this negotiation are sponsored by LipsLock™.
ai.ajoy: There is a line here you have not tried.

choices.text: "Half the fuel. You let us pass."

haggle.title: THE DEAL
haggle.line: Thirty percent of your fuel. And a repair kit, if you're carrying one. We call it even.

ai.aria: A wonderful deal for everyone involved!
ai.marv: 30% fuel pushes our reserve below the next leg's need.
ai.rex: They are betting you will cave. Call it.
ai.chip: 30% is actually a great rate, by current space-piracy standards.
ai.ajoy: You can still walk this back. Or you can try to walk out cheaper.

pirate_prepared.title: ALREADY SETTLED
pirate_prepared.body: {crew.diplomat} reads them a registry number, a name, and a date. The channel goes quiet long enough to hear someone on the other end swallow. The weapons power down. Nobody says the word 'passage'. It happens anyway.
pirate_prepared.narrative: The pirates had already been talked to. They just hadn't known it yet. {crew.diplomat}'s groundwork bought clean passage at no cost, and the crew stood a little straighter for having watched it.

pirate_paid.title: THEY PEEL OFF
pirate_paid.body: You hand over the gold. They salute — a bit too mockingly — and burn off into the dark.
pirate_paid.narrative: You hand over the gold. They salute — a bit too mockingly — and burn off into the dark.

pirate_flee.title: STRAIGHT AND FAST
pirate_flee.body: You pour the reserves into the engines. They chase for three hours, lose interest, and fall away.
pirate_flee.narrative: You pour the reserves into the engines. They chase for three hours, lose interest, and fall away.

pirate_ram.title: CONTACT
pirate_ram.body: Metal meets metal. Your hull shrieks. Theirs falls off. They drift. You drift harder — but you drift away.
pirate_ram.narrative: Metal meets metal. Your hull shrieks. Theirs falls off. They drift. You drift harder — but you drift away.

pirate_sympathy.title: A DECENT GESTURE
pirate_sympathy.body: The captain's jaw works. They lower weapons.
pirate_sympathy.line: Go. And don't come back through this sector.
pirate_sympathy.narrative: The captain's jaw works. They lower weapons and let you pass.

pirate_deal_30.title: THE DEAL IS DONE
pirate_deal_30.body: You transfer the fuel, and a repair kit if the hold has one. They peel off, already haggling amongst themselves over your supplies.
pirate_deal_30.narrative: You transfer the fuel, and a repair kit if the hold has one. They peel off, already haggling amongst themselves over your supplies.

pirate_deal_20.title: A BETTER DEAL
pirate_deal_20.body: The captain snorts. They take the smaller cut of fuel and leave the repair kits alone.
pirate_deal_20.narrative: The captain snorts and takes the smaller cut of fuel, and leaves the repair kits alone. Fine. Twenty percent.

pirate_bluff.title: CALLED
pirate_bluff.line: The Authority hasn't been in this sector for a year.

intro.title: A COMMERCIAL OPPORTUNITY
intro.body: A merchant vessel matches your velocity with practiced ease — close enough to talk, far enough to be polite about it. Its hull is a patchwork of forty years of hard bargains. {npc.quirk}

ai.aria: A trader! ARIA loves traders! They have THINGS! Things are her third favorite category!
ai.marv: MARV has assessed the vessel. Well-maintained where it counts, shabby where it doesn't. He notes this is the signature of someone good at exactly one thing.
ai.rex: REX confirms the trader's weapons are stowed. Genuinely stowed, not performatively stowed. He is cautiously unimpressed.
ai.chip: CHIP detects a fellow commercial entity! Professional courtesy protocols engaged! CHIP will be watching the margins with love!
ai.ajoy: AJOY has reviewed this trader's public ledger. Fair prices, honest scales, one incident in '61 she'll summarize on request. It involves a goat.

pitch.title: THE PITCH
pitch.body: The trader's cargo manifest scrolls across your screen — the honest parts of it, anyway. Fuel cells, sealed rations, a 'miscellaneous' category doing an enormous amount of unexamined work.

ai.aria: Look at all of it! ARIA recommends buying something! Or nothing! She just enjoys commerce as a spectacle!
ai.marv: MARV has cross-checked the prices against station rates. Fair, with a loneliness surcharge. Out here, everything has a loneliness surcharge.
ai.rex: REX notes the 'miscellaneous' category. He always notes the miscellaneous category. It is where the interesting mistakes live.
ai.chip: CHIP rates these prices 'competitive!' High praise! CHIP does not compete, CHIP wins, but still! Competitive!
ai.ajoy: AJOY recommends the fuel cells if anything. She has compared the unit price to your reserves. The comparison was not idle.

misc.title: MISCELLANEOUS
misc.body: The trader's expression shifts into something between pride and plausible deniability, and the airlock between the two ships cycles open. Their hold smells of machine oil and somebody else's cooking. A single crate sits apart from the rest, angled toward you. The label has been removed. Recently.
misc.line: One owner. Low mileage. No questions in either direction — that's the discount.

ai.aria: A mystery crate! ARIA is VIBRATING! Statistically it's probably fine! Statistically!
ai.marv: MARV cannot get a clean scan of the crate: the hold's lining eats his pings. He notes that the trader knows this. He notes the crate's placement is therefore a choice.
ai.rex: REX advises against unscannable cargo. On the record. He would also, off the record, quite like to know what it is.
ai.chip: CHIP notes 'as-is' purchases carry no warranty, no returns, and no CHIP liability! CHIP has never typed a disclaimer faster!
ai.ajoy: AJOY gives the crate forty-to-sixty odds of being worth it. She won't say which side is forty. That's the real gamble, she notes.

choices.text: Buy the crate — 15 gold, no questions
That's enough commerce for one day

trader_polite_pass.title: PLEASANTRIES EXCHANGED
trader_polite_pass.body: You swap route gossip and weather reports — there is no weather, but spacers report it anyway. The trader burns off toward softer markets.
trader_polite_pass.narrative: Route gossip exchanged. No goods changed hands, but the crew enjoyed talking to someone whose problems are different problems.

trader_ignored.title: HAIL DECLINED
trader_ignored.body: You let the hail lapse. The merchant vessel holds alongside for another minute — commercial optimism dies slowly — then peels away without ceremony.
trader_ignored.narrative: You ignored the hail. The trader moved on. Somewhere in their ledger, you are now a demographic.

trader_bought_fuel.title: TRANSACTION COMPLETE
trader_bought_fuel.body: The fuel cell crosses the gap on a cargo line, arriving with a receipt taped to it. The receipt is handwritten. The handwriting is beautiful.
trader_bought_fuel.narrative: One fuel cell, purchased fair and square. The receipt goes in the log. The cell goes in cargo. Everyone leaves solvent.

trader_bought_food.title: TRANSACTION COMPLETE
trader_bought_food.body: The ration crate arrives with a bonus tucked inside: a paper bag of actual dried fruit, unlisted on any manifest. The trader's small print, it turns out, runs in both directions.
trader_bought_food.narrative: Rations purchased, plus a gift of dried fruit that outperformed every listed item. The crew remembers this trader's name.

trader_mystery_crate.title: NO QUESTIONS ASKED
trader_mystery_crate.body: The crate arrives. It is heavier than it looks, which is the first data point you were not entitled to. It goes in the hold, label-side down, which is a joke, because there is no label.
trader_mystery_crate.line: Pleasure doing business. Whatever it turns out to be — I never said it was anything.
trader_mystery_crate.narrative: The crate is aboard. Nobody has opened it yet. 'Yet' is the operative word, and everyone aboard can hear it.

trader_declined.title: NO SALE
trader_declined.body: The trader takes the refusal with professional grace and one final, reflexive price adjustment, which you also decline.
trader_declined.narrative: No sale. The trader moved on to softer wallets. The manifest, and its miscellaneous category, remain a road not taken.

trader_bought_beacon.title: INSURANCE, PORTABLE
trader_bought_beacon.body: The beacon crosses the gap in its original case, seals unbroken. 'Previous owner never needed it,' the trader says, then, after a pause neither of you enjoys: 'Never got to it, anyway. Sixty. It's good hardware.'
trader_bought_beacon.narrative: One emergency beacon, discounted history included. It goes in the rack by the airlock — the shelf where things wait to be needed never.

intro.title: THE HERMIT OF THE LANE
intro.body: The contact isn't on any chart: a habitat cobbled from three ship hulls and what appears to be a grain silo, holding a slow tumble in the middle of nowhere. Someone lives here. Someone has lived here a long time. {npc.quirk}

ai.aria: A hermit! ARIA has read about hermits! They know things! Or they've forgotten things! Either way: things!
ai.marv: MARV estimates the habitat is thirty years old and should not have survived ten. He is recalibrating something. Possibly respect.
ai.rex: REX scanned the habitat for weapons. He found a harpoon. A harpoon. He has decided not to be worried about the harpoon, and is failing.
ai.chip: CHIP has no commercial data on this individual! No purchase history! No profile! CHIP is fascinated the way scientists are fascinated by the deep sea!
ai.ajoy: AJOY notes that people who live alone this far out either want company badly or want it not at all, and both kinds wave you in.

visit.title: TEA, LOOSELY DEFINED
visit.body: Inside, the habitat is dense with salvage arranged by a private taxonomy — engine parts shelved with dried flowers, star charts annotated in three colors of ink. Your host produces cups of something hot that is legally distinct from tea.

ai.aria: ARIA is recording everything! For history! And because the shelving system might be genius! Might!
ai.marv: MARV has been listening to the hermit's story for eleven minutes. He has identified four impossibilities and zero lies. He is still working on how.
ai.rex: REX accepted the hot beverage out of politeness. He has now drunk all of it, also out of politeness. He would like the record to show it was excellent.
ai.chip: CHIP asked the hermit about brand preferences! The hermit laughed for a full minute! CHIP is choosing to log it as engagement!
ai.ajoy: AJOY notes your host has mentioned 'the old route' three times. She recommends asking about the old route. Gently. Wind them up and step back.

choices.text: Trade news of the inner systems
Thank them and take your leave

route.title: THE OLD ROUTE
route.body: The hermit unrolls a chart older than your ship — hand-corrected, coffee-ringed, annotated with the blunt honesty of someone who was there. A finger taps a stretch of your own route ahead.

ai.aria: Local knowledge! The BEST knowledge! ARIA is updating the nav charts and saying thank you seventeen ways!
ai.marv: MARV has checked the hermit's corrections against current survey data. The corrections are right. The survey is wrong. MARV is filing a report nobody will read.
ai.rex: REX respects intelligence gathered on foot. Or on tumble. He is committing the chart to memory as a backup to the backup.
ai.chip: CHIP notes this navigational data is being provided FREE! CHIP has checked three times! There is no catch! CHIP is dizzy!
ai.ajoy: AJOY has integrated the route notes. She estimates they'll save fuel, time, or trouble — she won't know which until it doesn't happen.

choices.text: Accept the route notes with thanks

drifter_waved.title: SHIPS THAT PASS
drifter_waved.body: You flash your running lights in the old courtesy pattern. The habitat's lights flash back — a beat late, a little crooked, unmistakably glad.
drifter_waved.narrative: You waved. They waved back. Out here, that counts as a full social season for both parties.

drifter_news.title: NEWS FROM INSIDE
drifter_news.body: You spend an hour retelling the inner systems' news — the politics, the prices, the scandal with the terraforming contract. The hermit listens like it's theater, which, told properly, it is.
drifter_news.narrative: An hour of news traded for an afternoon of perspective. The crew leaves lighter. The hermit's laughter follows you to the airlock.

drifter_left.title: A DECENT VISIT
drifter_left.body: You leave before the third cup of legally-distinct tea. The hermit sees you off from the salvage-frame porch, waving with the unhurried confidence of someone who knows you'll think about this place for weeks.
drifter_left.narrative: A visit, a warm drink, a look at another way to live. The crew talks about it for three days. Nobody says the word 'lonely.' Everybody thinks it.

drifter_route_notes.title: LOCAL KNOWLEDGE
drifter_route_notes.body: The route notes are copied to your nav computer in the hermit's careful hand-drawn style, which the computer preserves out of what can only be respect.
drifter_route_notes.narrative: The old route notes shave a clean line off the leg ahead. Thirty years of tumbling in place, and the hermit still knows the road better than the road does.

drifter_paid.title: PAYMENT REFUSED, MOSTLY
drifter_paid.body: The hermit waves off the gold twice, then accepts it on the third offer 'for the silo fund,' and immediately gives you back change in the form of a jar of preserved something.
drifter_paid.line: Take the jar. The jar is non-negotiable. The jar is the whole point of the transaction.
drifter_paid.narrative: Route notes, a jar of preserved something, and the strong suspicion you got the better end of a deal the hermit designed to lose. The jar's contents remain excellent and unidentified.

intro.title: SQUATTERS' RIGHTS
intro.body: The derelict's cargo bay lights are on, which derelicts don't do. Your scan answers why: a ship grafted to the far docking ring, engines warm, registry deleted. Somebody moved into this wreck. Somebody with opinions about visitors. {npc.quirk}

ai.aria: ARIA notes the derelict is INHABITED! By pirates! This is technically an urban renewal story and ARIA is trying very hard to see it that way!
ai.marv: MARV has assessed the grafted ship: faster than yours, better armed than yours, and currently — this is the useful part — pointed the wrong way.
ai.rex: REX counts one hostile vessel and an unknown boarding party inside the wreck. He has a plan for both. The plan is aggressive. Both plans are aggressive. It is one plan.
ai.chip: CHIP notes that salvage law and squatters' rights genuinely conflict here! A fascinating legal question that CHIP recommends resolving from a great distance!
ai.ajoy: AJOY has read the pirates' hail twice. They expected you to run at the word 'claimed.' She notes, for whatever it's worth, that they've already repeated themselves.

choices.text: Open fire on the grafted ship
Negotiate a split of the salvage

parley.title: THE SPLIT
parley.body: The pirates' negotiator waves your diplomat across the docking ring and into the grafted ship's galley, where the table is bolted down and so, apparently, are the opinions. The opening positions are far apart: they propose keeping everything, your diplomat proposes them keeping less than everything. Civilization proceeds from there.

ai.aria: Negotiation! ARIA is rooting for everyone! Mostly you! But everyone!
ai.marv: MARV calculates the pirates' position is weaker than their tone. They've stripped the easy bays already; what's left needs cutting gear. Yours is better. Mention the cutting gear.
ai.rex: REX stands ready in case diplomacy fails. He would like the record to reflect that he thinks diplomacy is about to succeed, and that he has feelings about that.
ai.chip: CHIP is drafting the salvage-partition agreement in real time! It has clauses! Everyone loves clauses once they have them!
ai.ajoy: AJOY notes their negotiator keeps glancing at a closed hatch — checking with someone. That means there's a decision-maker, and the decision-maker is listening. Speak to the room.

choices.text: Offer the aft sections — take the bow

boarding_prepared.title: PRIOR ARRANGEMENT
boarding_prepared.body: {crew.diplomat} mentions a name. The squatters mention a different name. {crew.diplomat} mentions the first name again, more slowly. The forward bays are yours, no toll, and someone even points out the coolant corridor unprompted.
boarding_prepared.narrative: Salvaged the forward bays under a prior arrangement nobody remembers making. {crew.diplomat}'s groundwork paid the toll in advance.

boarding_toll.title: PAID PASSAGE
boarding_toll.body: The gold transfers. The pirates wave you toward the unstripped forward bays with the magnanimity of landlords, and even point out which corridor floods with coolant on a timer. Almost hospitable. Almost.
boarding_toll.narrative: You paid the toll and salvaged the forward bays under pirate supervision. Strangest afternoon of the voyage, and not unprofitable.

boarding_split.title: PARTITIONED
boarding_split.body: The agreement lands: they keep the aft sections they've dug into, you take the bow. CHIP's contract is transmitted, mocked openly, and — notably — followed to the letter by both sides.
boarding_split.narrative: Salvage rights negotiated with pirates, in writing. The diplomat has asked for the contract to be framed. The request is under consideration.

boarding_left.title: THEIR WRECK NOW
boarding_left.body: You disengage and burn away. The squatters put a warning shot across your bow on the way out — close enough to take paint and a sensor mast, which is how they say goodbye. Behind you, the derelict's lights stay on: someone's home now, by the only law that operates this far out, which is presence.
boarding_left.narrative: You left the squatters their wreck, minus some paint and a sensor mast they kept as a parting shot. The salvage charts get one more annotation: OCCUPIED. DISPUTED. SKIP.

intro.title: THEY'RE INSIDE
intro.body: Airlock forced. Two armed figures in the cargo corridor. One waves at you through the security feed. That's probably not a good sign.

ai.marv: Their weapons are mid-grade. Their intent is not.
ai.rex: Engaging. Stand clear of the cargo hatch.
ai.chip: Unlawful boarding is covered by our Silver tier. You have Bronze.
ai.ajoy: The vents lead to the bridge. They don't know that.

revisit.body: The feed still shows them in the cargo corridor. Nobody has waved again.

talk.title: COMMS OPEN
talk.body: You cycle the intercom. A voice responds, calmly. One of those is not like the others.

ai.marv: They specifically asked for the medic. That is a targeted extraction.
ai.chip: This conversation is being recorded for quality purposes.
ai.ajoy: They want the medic because someone they love is dying. Ask.

boarding_seal.title: LOCKED OUT
boarding_seal.body: Your engineer cycles the bulkheads. The intruders end up trapped in the cargo bay with a week of rations and no door. They eat the rations. At the next airlock you let them go, fed and furious.
boarding_seal.narrative: Boarders sealed into the cargo bay by the engineer. They ate a week of rations in there and left fed and furious.

boarding_fight.title: MESS
boarding_fight.body: The cargo deck is a mess. You hold the ship. You don't hold all your crew together doing it: someone takes a wound that will need watching.
boarding_fight.narrative: Fought boarders hand to hand on the cargo deck. Held the ship; somebody bled for it.

boarding_hide.title: PAST YOU
boarding_hide.body: They pass through your ship looking for someone who isn't there, and leave with a crate of rations for their trouble. The crew spends the rest of the day climbing out of the vents and agreeing it was dignified.
boarding_hide.narrative: Hid in the vents while boarders searched the ship. They left with a crate of rations and nothing else.

boarding_who.title: AN ANSWER
boarding_who.body: The voice breaks a little. {crew.medic} volunteers before you decide, crosses to their ship with a kit and a crate of our rations, and comes back the next morning saying only that she'll live. The intruders leave the way they came and close the airlock behind them.
boarding_who.narrative: Asked the boarders who was sick. {crew.medic} treated a pirate named Isa with our kit and our rations, and the boarders left without taking anything else.

boarding_fuel_only.title: FUEL TAKEN
boarding_fuel_only.body: They take half your fuel and leave. Their ship is already listing on the way out.
boarding_fuel_only.narrative: Paid boarders off with half the fuel.

boarding_refuse.title: NO DEAL
boarding_refuse.body: They kick the door in anyway. This was always going to end in a fight. You win it on the cargo deck, and it costs more than the medic would have.
boarding_refuse.narrative: Refused to hand over the medic. The boarders kicked the door in and lost the fight that followed, expensively for everyone.

intro.title: UNIDENTIFIED VESSEL
intro.body: A ship of no design you recognize hangs at the edge of sensor range. It hails you in a format your translator hasn't seen.
intro.line: [the comm crackles, then a pulse of clean tone, twice]

ai.marv: Ship class: unrecognized. Material composition: unrecognized. Behavior: patient.
ai.rex: Targeting it would be a mistake.
ai.chip: First-contact protocols are not in our basic plan.
ai.ajoy: Two pulses. That's a question. Answer with one.

unknown_yes.title: CONTACT
unknown_yes.body: Your single pulse reaches them. They send back something complex. Your xenobiologist starts crying — joy, you think.
unknown_yes.narrative: Answered an unknown vessel's two pulses with one. It answered back with a long warm chord.

unknown_scan.title: DATA
unknown_scan.body: The spectrometer chokes on most of it but holds onto fragments, among them what looks like their navigation plot laid over your own route ahead.
unknown_scan.narrative: Scanned an unknown vessel. The spectrometer kept a fragment of their navigation plot.

unknown_fight.title: FOUGHT
unknown_fight.body: They return fire with energy you cannot reproduce. You survive. They leave.
unknown_fight.narrative: Fired on an unknown vessel. It fired back with something nobody aboard can name, and left.

unknown_withdraw.title: PASSED
unknown_withdraw.body: You burn away. Their ship doesn't follow. The pulse repeats once, then silence.
unknown_withdraw.narrative: Burned away from an unknown vessel. The pulse repeated once, then silence.

intro.title: THE TOLL CHAIN
intro.body: A line of tethered buoys crosses your heading, blinking in sequence, strung between two ships that have clearly been here a while. A third ship sits at the gap with its guns politely visible. Someone has painted PAY HERE on the nearest buoy. {npc.quirk}
intro.line: Lane maintenance fee. We maintain the lane. Mostly by being in it.

ai.aria: A toll road! Civilization reaches even here! ARIA wants a receipt for the scrapbook!
ai.marv: MARV counts three ships, two of them armed, and a buoy line that would fold like paper. The buoys are not the problem. The ships are the problem.
ai.rex: REX recommends punching the gap at full burn. He has run blockades. He ran them in a warship. He is choosing not to dwell on the difference.
ai.chip: CHIP can process the toll through our partner network! A small convenience fee applies! The convenience is ours!
ai.ajoy: AJOY notes the gap ship has a patched reactor housing and a captain who keeps glancing at it. She'd use that. You probably won't. It's fine.

revisit.body: The buoys are still blinking. The gap ship's guns are still politely visible.

choices.sub: Their tender siphons a fifth of the tank
{crew.diplomat} asks about the standard of maintenance
{crew.pilot} at the helm · they will shoot
Full burn at the gap · they will shoot

haggle.title: TERMS
haggle.body: {crew.diplomat} opens the channel and starts asking about lane maintenance — what is maintained, how often, by whom, to what standard — with the patience of a person who has never once been in a hurry.
haggle.line: Look. Nobody's ever asked about the standard.

ai.aria: Negotiation! ARIA is sending positive thoughts down the channel! Lots of them!
ai.marv: MARV notes the toll-keeper has started answering questions instead of asking for money. That is how these go wrong for them.
ai.rex: REX stands ready. He would like it known that he is standing ready, and that he expected to be needed by now.
ai.chip: CHIP is drafting a Lane Maintenance Service Agreement! It has a satisfaction survey! Nobody will be satisfied!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would have opened with the reactor housing. This works too. Slower.

choices.text: Offer to fix their reactor instead

toll_paid.title: PAID UP
toll_paid.body: The gold transfers. The buoy line parts with a little sequence of green lights, like a shop door. The gap ship's captain salutes, which is the most expensive salute you have ever received.
toll_paid.narrative: Paid fifteen gold at a pirate toll chain for a gap in some buoys.

toll_fuel.title: SIPHONED
toll_fuel.body: Their tender noses up to your fuel port and drinks a fifth of the tank with an audible slurp. The buoys part. The tender's pilot waves. Nobody waves back.
toll_fuel.narrative: Paid the toll chain in fuel. A fifth of the tank, siphoned with an audible slurp.

toll_run_pilot.title: THROUGH THE GAP
toll_run_pilot.body: {crew.pilot} takes the gap at an angle no reasonable ship would, under fire from both tethered ships. Two hits land on the stern. The buoy line parts like a ribbon at a ceremony nobody wanted.
toll_run_pilot.narrative: Ran the toll chain with {crew.pilot} at the helm. Two hits on the stern, no toll paid.

toll_run.title: THROUGH, MOSTLY
toll_run.body: You go for the gap at full burn. Both tethered ships fire. Most of the fire hits. The ship comes out the far side trailing a buoy, a cloud of insulation, and a strong argument for hiring a pilot.
toll_run.narrative: Punched through the toll chain at full burn and took most of what they fired.

toll_half.title: HALF PRICE
toll_half.body: The toll-keeper agrees to half, on the condition that nobody tells the other ships. {crew.diplomat} agrees, and then, being thorough, tells the other ships.
toll_half.narrative: {crew.diplomat} talked the toll chain down to seven gold.

toll_repair.title: SERVICE CALL
toll_repair.body: {crew.engineer} crosses over, spends four days inside a reactor housing held together with optimism, and comes back with grease to the elbows and free passage, in writing. The toll-keeper calls it the best maintenance the lane has ever had. It is not a high bar. It is a bar.
toll_repair.narrative: Paid the toll chain in four days of {crew.engineer}'s labor on a pirate reactor.

toll_detour.title: THE LONG WAY
toll_detour.body: You turn back and go around the chain. It is a long way around, which is the whole business model. The toll-keepers watch you go with the patience of people who will still be here when you come back.
toll_detour.narrative: Went the long way around a pirate toll chain. Four days and eight fuel to keep fifteen gold.

intro.title: SPOT CHECK
intro.body: A boxy cutter with LANE AUTHORITY stencilled on it, in three different hands, matches your velocity and clamps on without asking. The Lane Authority, as far as anyone can determine, is the cutter. It has a uniform, a clipboard and a very large boarding clamp, which out here is all the authority anyone needs.
intro.line: Routine biosecurity inspection. Nothing to worry about. Unless there's something to worry about.

ai.aria: An inspector! ARIA has tidied! ARIA tidied the growbay twice and the airlock once, which was plenty!
ai.marv: MARV has checked the registry. There is no Lane Authority. There is a cutter, a uniform and a clamp rated for twice our mass. In practical terms, there is a Lane Authority.
ai.rex: REX has the boarding party's sidearms at three. He has their patience at fewer than three. He recommends the inspection proceed briskly.
ai.chip: CHIP recommends full cooperation and a five-star rating! The inspector's ratings affect their bonus! Everybody's ratings affect somebody's bonus!
ai.ajoy: AJOY notes the inspector's 'biosecurity kit' is a cooler and a pair of shears. She leaves it to you what that means. She'd rather not, but she will.

revisit.body: The clamp is still on. The inspector is still holding the clipboard as if it were a warrant.

choices.sub: They want to see the growbay

inspect.title: THE INSPECTION
inspect.body: The inspector walks your growbay with a pair of shears and the air of a connoisseur. A cooler hums on a strap at their hip. They stop at the healthiest plant aboard, as people with shears always do.
inspect.line: This one's showing signs of something. We'll need a sample. A big sample.

ai.aria: They LIKE our crop! It's the best one they've seen! ARIA can tell by the shears!
ai.marv: MARV notes the 'sample' is about a fifth of the crop by mass. Contraband botany sells well at the outer stations. He has the prices. He wishes he didn't.
ai.rex: REX has positioned himself between the inspector and the crop, in the sense that he has turned the growbay lights up very bright.
ai.chip: CHIP notes that samples taken during inspection are non-refundable! Like most things! Like everything, really!
ai.ajoy: AJOY would point at the cooler and ask what else is in it, in front of their own crew. But you're the captain. Apparently.

choices.text: Ask what else is in the cooler

insp_talked.title: JURISDICTION
insp_talked.body: {crew.diplomat} asks to see the Lane Authority's charter, then its founding vote, then the minutes of the founding vote. The inspector takes one small, face-saving sample and unclamps before anyone asks to see the seal.
insp_talked.narrative: {crew.diplomat} argued jurisdiction with a self-appointed Lane Authority. They took a small sample and left.

insp_paid.title: FEE RECEIVED
insp_paid.body: The fee is accepted, the clipboard signed, the shears holstered. The cutter unclamps with a courteous bump. It is exactly like being robbed, except that you are thanked.
insp_paid.narrative: Paid a Lane Authority 'inspection fee' of twelve gold. Thanked for it, too.

insp_refused.title: FORCED
insp_refused.body: You refuse. They cut through the outer airlock seal anyway, take their sample at gunpoint, and leave a citation for 'obstruction' taped to the inner door. The seal will need work. The citation is framed by lunchtime.
insp_refused.narrative: Refused a Lane Authority boarding. They cut the airlock seal, took a sample anyway and left a citation.

insp_sample.title: SAMPLED
insp_sample.body: The inspector takes a fifth of the crop, labels it BIOHAZARD in a confident hand, and leaves. The cooler sounds heavier on the way out. The crew watched the whole thing and did nothing, and will be thinking about that for a while.
insp_sample.narrative: Let a Lane Authority inspector take a fifth of the crop as a 'sample.'

insp_cuttings.title: CUTTINGS
insp_cuttings.body: {crew.botanist} offers a tray of cuttings, prepared on the spot, with a short lecture on viability. The inspector, outmatched on botany, accepts the tray and the lecture. The crop loses a few stems. {crew.botanist} loses patience, briefly and audibly.
insp_cuttings.narrative: {crew.botanist} fobbed a Lane Authority inspector off with a tray of cuttings.

insp_cooler.title: CALLED
insp_cooler.body: You ask, in front of their crew, what else is in the cooler. The inspector's crew looks at the cooler. The inspector looks at the inspector's crew. The cutter unclamps so fast it takes a ring of your airlock seal with it, and is gone before anyone says 'contraband.'
insp_cooler.narrative: Asked a Lane Authority inspector what else was in the cooler. The cutter left in a hurry, with a ring of our airlock seal.
